acceptance: A determination is recorded under _project/decisions/ naming both APIs and their terms
If the determination is accepted risk rather than clearance, that is stated plainly, following the joinorder precedent
The determination states whether it covers redistribution in the wheel, in the repo, or both
context: Flagged in the plan under "Open items to settle before implementation". Precedent: _project/decisions/joinorder-canonical-data-licensing-2026-05-12.md
description:
pricing_data.yaml ships inside the runtime wheel. Before a generator starts pulling values from vendor APIs into that file, confirm the terms permit redistributing the derived values.

Sources in question: the AWS Price List API (pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/...) and the Azure Retail Prices API (prices.azure.com/api/retail/prices). Both are public and unauthenticated, which is suggestive but not dispositive.

The repo has a directly relevant precedent: _project/decisions/joinorder-canonical-data-licensing-2026-05-12.md, where re-hosting an upstream dataset was resolved as an explicit project-owner risk acceptance rather than a clean legal clearance. Follow that shape - reach a recorded determination, even if the determination is accepted risk.

This blocks the generator work, not the data correction: hand-transcribing a published list price into a config file is a different act from automatically mirroring a vendor's price feed.
